answer: You can tell a cutler's blade by the edge, not by the shine. Proof of cutler blade via grind pass log is the cutler's proof: a blade the cutler grinds only after 21 passes run true, each pass drawn by the cutler himself. The atlas is the hard steel the blade is ground from. The jetty is the fine edge that takes the hair off an arm. The yarrow is the cold water the hot blade is quenched in. A forger must draw 21 passes true, hone 21 passes and test 21 passes, half a day at the wheel for a blade that still will not hold an edge.
